notes.title: New Desert Block Battle level!
notes.notes:
Check out this new desert Block Battle which is sure to challenge all players!  With fewer ground areas to cling on to, make sure to watch your step as you try to catch more blocks than your opponent.

This new level is free for all players, no paid DLC required!

Please let other players know what you think of the new level and the rest of our recent updates in a review!

notes.title: Release 0.8
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a slow motion effect at the end of each level
[*] Added the player glide particle effect to the multiplayer characters
[*] Added an explosion force to the bombs, but only affects the scenery right now
[/list]

[b]Crash Fixes & Defects[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the level 5 boss crash due to dying 3 times (broke in 0.7)
[*] Fixed the level 10 boss crash due to dying 3 times (broke in 0.7)
[*] Fixed the tree falling at the start of level 3
[/list]

[b]Interface Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed all of the menu buttons on the level 10 boss
[*] Fixed the campaign level selection grid
[/list]

[b]What are we working on next?[/b]
[list]
[*] Adding some more multiplayer levels
[*] Adding the explosion force to affect the players (character controllers)
[*] Adding the ability to choose a number of lives for multiplayer
[*] Adding an HMI indicator to show how many lives left
[*] Adding leaderboards within the game so you don't have to view them online
[*] Adding a skip button to the level 10 boss intro
[/list]

notes.title: Release 0.7
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the block pickup radius to fix issues where collision wouldn't trigger
[*] Added a limit of three lives for single player and multiplayer
[/list]

[b]Interface Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added controls to set Battle Time in multiplayer
[*] Added control to turn off clock drops in multiplayer
[*] Added Quit/Exit menu button
[/list]

[b]Stats & Leaderboards[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a stat/leaderboard for total blocks (only viewable in Steam Community)
[*] Added a stat/leaderboard for total deaths (only viewable in Steam Community)
[/list]
